card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 5, 2, 1, 3 or 4) that starts a number whose next digit is a zero, such as 50, 20, 10 or 200. It is seen in ratios, dose ranges and tables.

modes.label: Ratios
modes.description: The first digit of a mixture ratio such as 50:50.
modes.example: evaluate Iodomethane (Midas) in a 50:<<5>>0 combination with chloropicrin.

modes.label: Doses and day ranges
modes.description: The leading digit of a round dose or day number.

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: A leading digit inside rows of numbers in a table.
